models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.hardware: RTX 3090 24GB, inference stack optimised by a r/LocalLLaMA developer (MTP + DFlash2 spec-decode + context lookup, 16-token verification batches)
engines.quant: DFlash2 speculative decoding with context lookup and 16 tokens verified per step; reproduce-a-document task (25K+ tokens); the underlying stack starts at ~82 t/s and reaches ~133-138 t/s in ordinary chat

engines.hardware: Single Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB + 24GB DDR5 system RAM (~16GB used), a custom llama.cpp fork streaming the KV cache between VRAM and system RAM
engines.quant: IQ4_XS; Q4 KV values + Q8 keys, MTP speculative decoding, N-gram prediction; ~200K context (262K targeted); 42.7 t/s at ~20K context, 658 t/s prefill

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PlayStation 5, 12 GiB of direct GPU memory, native app on Mihawk-99's RADV Vulkan port
engines.quant: 2-bit UD-IQ2_XXS; 9-21 tok/s range; models load from USB straight into GPU memory (no mmap); PS5LM v0.1 (GPL-3.0)

models.why: Qwen3.8-27B is the model the local-AI crowd tunes hardest: ~382 tok/s on an RTX 3090 with DFlash2 + context lookup (4.6x its ~82 t/s baseline), ~35 t/s at 200K context on a single 16GB RX 9060 XT via a KV-streaming llama.cpp fork, and 9-21 t/s on a jailbroken PS5 through PS5LM's Vulkan port.
